conditions: Local profiles may run concurrently on the same host. Hosted profiles use their declared runner environment. Three observations and reused owner fixtures do not establish workload latency percentiles, engine rankings or production popularity. Sum of timed qualification stages excludes untimed caller/fixture overhead.

6df0f7c0342a6e74386714c96d110ae9d15d5a5c.scope: Three actual acquisitions of an existing owner-qualified fixture; not an application corpus, popularity sample or latency service-level guarantee.
6df0f7c0342a6e74386714c96d110ae9d15d5a5c.acquisition: Fresh context inspection, offline analysis, native acquisition and reconciliation measured separately. Up to three bounded attempts; stale attempts remain in the report. No candidate execution or application-value sampling.
6df0f7c0342a6e74386714c96d110ae9d15d5a5c.bytes: Canonical contract, native evidence and plan serialization plus actual exported one-query closure and disposable cache file contents. Filesystem blocks, install payloads and connection credentials are excluded.
6df0f7c0342a6e74386714c96d110ae9d15d5a5c.cache: Cold lookup opens a new cache object against existing files; warm lookups reuse an object. Neither drops OS page caches or claims current remote freshness. All recorded lookups must remain unverified.
6df0f7c0342a6e74386714c96d110ae9d15d5a5c.environment: Owner fixtures may already have warmed driver/server state; SDK ownership and transport boundaries remain adapter-specific. Compare only the declared environment, not engines as universal performance rankings.
